purpose: Replace type-only labels for the Type-0x20 interaction, Type-0x42 counter, and Type-0x29 response paths.

promotions.name: ActorCollision_ProcessType20Interaction

contract.terminal: Routes a Type-0x82 source through Actor_ApplyTerminalCollisionResponse
contract.interaction: Otherwise clears the source, runs Actor_HandleType2DInteraction, and advances TerrainScene5RandomStep
contract.selection: Chooses the common terminal response below 0xC8 or installs animation 0x001233CC and clears transient fields

evidence: Direct Type-0x82 source test and shared terminal-response transfers
Direct TerrainScene5RandomStep call and Type-0x20 interaction animation write

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_AdvancePrimaryCounter

contract.counter: Advances INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS through four primary-digit steps unless it is already 99
contract.response: Resets the Type-0x42 collision step, optionally queues event 0x0C, and transfers to PlayerCollision_ReinitializeResponseActor

evidence: Exact 76-byte body ending at the branch into the shared response tail
Direct INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS comparison and four InteractionCounter_AdvancePrimaryDigits calls
Direct ACTOR_TYPE42_COLLISION_STEP reset and event-0x0C audio path

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_SpawnType29Response

contract.setup: Publishes PLAYER_COLLISION_TYPE29_SPAWN_GATE and installs the Type-0x84 actor animation/movement response
contract.allocation: Allocates a forward-slot companion from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_COLLISION_TYPE_84 and copies source X/Y

evidence: Direct gate write and Type-0x29 animation/movement stream references
Existing Type-0x29 response placement description and template load

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish the Type-0x20 interaction response, Type-0x42 primary-counter response, and Type-0x29 response allocator while retaining dispatch-type aliases.
